basic_info.description: Super cute starter home conveniently located just half block from Noriega Street public transit, shops & restaurants. Just short blocks from Ocean Beach, parks, Sunset library, Sunset Playgrounds, and several schools nearby! Top floor features 2 bedroom side by side in the front, full bath, living room, and kitchen with dine-in area. Kitchen opens to a good-sized deck offering gorgeous ocean views. Ground floor legally adds an additional bedroom & bath plus one large car parking space. Huge yard!
